basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 15-year-old from a small town in the Midwest. I'm still figuring out a lot about myself, including my gender identity and sexuality. I love connecting with others who are on a similar journey. My interests include music, especially punk bands like Against Me!, and exploring new shows on Netflix. I'm in high school and spend my free time either with friends or browsing Reddit. I'm currently single and not actively looking, but open to new friendships. I usually log onto Reddit in the evenings after school, around 6 PM to 10 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm still learning about gender identity and LGBTQ+ issues, mostly through online resources and conversations with my LGBTQ+ friends. I enjoy self-teaching through reading and engaging in discussions on various subreddits.
